title: Closing Thank-You Amount in Cartwise Shopper Payouts Card Settlements
content:
**Settlement rule — closing thank-you on Everyday Pay Card cashback settlements (Cartwise Shopper Payouts)**

A closing thank-you is added when there is a month to settle: a shopper with 40 or more batch base-pay entries in the last 3 months gets 5 percent of the shared figure after the card tenure bonus, rounded to the cent; one with 20 to 39 gets a fixed 1.50; and any other shopper gets nothing.

**Terms used.**

- *Batch base-pay entries* are the base-pay entries posted on the shopper's batches in Cartwise Shopper Batches (the pay postings of the batch base-pay component).
- *The last 3 months* counts the entries booked fewer than 3 whole months before the day of the closing.
- *A month to settle* means the closing cashback settlement has a capped statement month above zero; where the month settles nothing, no thank-you is added.
- *The shared figure after the card tenure bonus* is the capped statement month multiplied by the closing share and then raised by the card tenure bonus, unrounded.

The thank-you is added to the shared figure after the card tenure bonus, and the settlement is rounded to the cent only on that final figure.

**Input — judgement — output.**

| Base-pay entries in the last 3 months | Month to settle? | Closing thank-you |
|---|---|---|
| 40 or more | yes | 5 percent (0.05) of the shared figure after the card tenure bonus, rounded to the cent |
| 20 to 39 | yes | a fixed 1.50 |
| 19 or fewer | yes | no thank-you |
| any number | no | no thank-you |

**Hypothetical cases** (figures invented for illustration):

- 40 base-pay entries; shared figure after the card tenure bonus 10.60: thank-you 0.53 (5 percent of 10.60); settlement 11.13.
- 39 base-pay entries; shared figure after the bonus 10.60: thank-you 1.50; settlement 12.10.
- 20 base-pay entries; the latest month already carries a payment, so there is no month to settle: no thank-you.
- 19 base-pay entries: no thank-you.
